cards.subject: A sealed vault
lines: It sat quiet under the desert until Ironforge dwarves part-excavated it and woke the troggs the titans had shut inside. Most of that expedition was slaughtered.
Everything you fight down here is a consequence of somebody digging.

cards.subject: Baelog, Eric and Olaf
lines: Blizzard put its own 1992 puzzle-platformer into the game. Baleog the Fierce, Erik the Swift, Olaf the Stout — horned helmets and all.
Their camp holds Baelog's Chest: his big book of recipes, his journal, his shortbow.
Three lost dwarves, in a titan vault, still camping.

cards.subject: The journal is readable
lines: It describes how to unlock the Chamber of Khaz'mul with the Staff of Prehistoria.
They worked out the vault's lock and wrote it down.
They stayed lost anyway.

cards.subject: You cannot finish without robbing them
lines: The sealed door needs a staff assembled from two halves: the Gni'kiv Medallion out of Baelog's Chest, and the Shaft of Tsol off Revelosh.
Patch 4.1.0 deleted the item. You just click the keystone now.
The staff still appears in the door animation — an object nobody can hold any more.

cards.subject: Revelosh
lines: The earthen were the original titan-made stone people. Dwarves are earthen after the curse of flesh got at them.
So a dwarf fighting him is a descendant fighting an unchanged ancestor.
In the building that holds the proof.

cards.subject: The troggs are the first draft
cards.tag: The failures are still filed here
lines: The titans made earthen. Something went wrong and made troggs instead.
They did not destroy them. They sealed them in Uldaman and moved on.
The dungeon is a filing cabinet, and the failures woke up.

cards.subject: This is where Gnomeregan died
lines: They followed the surviving dwarves underground toward Dun Morogh.
Then they diverted.
The gnomes lost their city because dwarves opened a door in the Badlands.

cards.subject: "Me Grimlok, KING!"
lines: A trogg who can think, which among troggs makes him a king. He holds the Stonevault clan by intimidation.
He keeps a trained basilisk at his side specifically so rivals can see what happens to rivals.

cards.subject: Galgann Firehammer
lines: A senator of Shadowforge City, sent to run the excavation so his emperor could turn whatever is buried here into a weapon.
"By Thaurissan's Beard! Slay them!"
The Dark Iron came into this vault specifically to keep their cousins out of it.

cards.subject: The vault had staff
lines: The golems are described as having staffed and operated the great titan vault — not guards bolted on afterwards, but the building's original employees.
They are still doing the job, several hundred thousand years after the last supervisor left.

cards.subject: Ironaya
cards.tag: You have to unseal her to fight her
lines: A titan watcher who oversaw Uldaman's construction and then went into hibernation inside it.
On release: "None may steal the secrets of the Makers."
She is correct about what you are doing.

cards.subject: The statues along the walls
lines: They are not decoration. At two-thirds health six Earthen Guardians step off the wall; at a third, two Vault Warders follow.
"Who dares awaken Archaedas? Who dares the wrath of the Makers?"
Then: "Awake, ye servants! Defend the Disks!"

cards.subject: The Discs of Norgannon
lines: A Lore Keeper of Norgannon materialises and says out loud where dwarves come from: earthen, made of living stone by the titans, turned to flesh by a curse.
It is the largest lore revelation in the whole game.
It is delivered at the back of a level forty five-man that most players skip.
